title: Viewing the Agentic Security Operations Platform Status Board

blocks.text: To view the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) status board, refer to the status page. The status board presents historic and current incidents.
On the status board, you can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: View the current status of the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal.
View incident history and historical uptime.
